correctness.rationale: Exact finite claim for GP(10,2): define outer cycle u_i u_(i+1), spokes u_i v_i, inner v_i v_(i+2), each for i mod 10. Vertex OCT means remaining induced graph bipartite. Independently implemented exact enumeration in a newly written standard-library program that tested all 60,460 subsets of 20 vertices of sizes 0..6 (zero feasible below six, exactly 3240 at six), constructed all feasible one-removal/one-addition arcs and all-pairs BFS. Independently obtained 31800 undirected exchange edges, degree histogram (12:150,14:480,15:240,16:30,17:240,18:120,19:120,20:240,21:480,22:120,23:240,24:260,25:360,26:120,27:40), eccentricity 6 for every one of 3240 states, and exactly all 10 metric table entries including 67,480 (ordered) excess pairs. Every BFS reached all 3240 states, and every counted pair satisfied h <= d <= h+1; strict cases exist. Independently checked the nonmatroid witness {1,5,7,9,11,14}, {6,9,10,12,13,15}: both feasible, replacing 5 by any vertex of T\S fails. Inspected both repository verifier algorithms (including checked GP-to-LCF isomorphism) and both output JSON files. Actual frozen source Git tree reconstructed independently from all ten listed file blob identities and matched 92d25604fcaaf3a6f5b86560ed0c6f75e0799f03. Complete exhaustive finite computation is a proof for this fixed graph and all its allowed states, not an infinite-family extrapolation.

value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical exceptional cubic fullerene for bipartite induced-subgraph bounds. Maximum induced bipartite subgraphs and their optimum-preserving vertex exchanges form a natural optimization reconfiguration object: feasibility can constrain paths substantially beyond the Johnson lower bound. A complete exact 3240-state metric, self-centered nonregular structure, sharp one-step detour bound with exact 33740 unordered obstructions, and a specific violation of matroid basis-exchange characterize the geometry of all optimal solutions rather than simply recomputing the known scalar optimum of six. This is mathematically motivated and could serve as a natural exact benchmark for feasible-solution reconfiguration, without requiring an all-fullerene generalization.
residual_risks: Single finite graph, no claimed theorem for every generalized Petersen graph or fullerene.
The one-detour bound is a natural and substantive classification here but cannot be extrapolated to all optimum OCT families.

scientific_limitations: Exactly fixed graph GP(10,2); no graph-family general theorem or novel scalar OCT cardinality.
The new review is not itself publication, an independent external expert attestation, or a formal proof-assistant certificate.
